context_summary: F55 adds parallax image backgrounds (mountains default, desert available) behind the existing procedural BackgroundDecor. Single-layer images placed at deep Z, scrolling with reduced parallax factor. Low risk, purely visual, no gameplay impact.

options_considered.description: Add a ParallaxBackground component that renders the image as a textured plane at deep Z behind BackgroundDecor, integrated with BiomeTransition for theme switching.
pros: Simple implementation — one new component, minimal changes to existing code
Leverages existing theme/biome system for automatic switching
Images tile/repeat horizontally for infinite scrolling
Mountains default works well with current forest theme
cons: Single-layer parallax (no multi-layer depth) — limited depth illusion

options_considered.description: Replace BackgroundDecor entirely with image-based parallax layers (remove procedural mountains/clouds).
pros: Cleaner visual consistency — no mixing of procedural and image styles
cons: Larger scope — need images for all 5 themes
Loses procedural cloud animation and biome transition interpolation

rationale: Option A is low-risk and additive. The parallax image sits behind everything as a sky fill, complementing the existing procedural decor. The user explicitly said to keep procedural elements in front. Single feature, 2-3 tasks, can ship in 1-2 waves.
